task.title: Allocating earnings — Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 8 - Your earnings were not deducted .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the vacation pay.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 2 - Non-misrepresentation .

Remarks Line 1: Type “Input M175 V-$XXXX (amount to allocate) from XXXX (first day of allocation) to XXXX (last day of allocation), $XXX (amount to be allocated on last week if different).” Example of transaction: V-$700-1679-1682-$400
Remarks Line 5: Type your name and telephone number.

Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes to clear the registration number.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the appropriate registration number from the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if the earnings was declared on the claimant’s report:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 27.
If no, go to step 28.

step.cmd: In FTS, determine the status of the claimant’s reports:

ul.li: If the claimant’s reports were processed, refer to Modifying a claimant’s report to correct the information. Modifying a claimant’s report
If the claimant’s reports were not processed, refer to Actioning a rejected claimant’s report to re-input the reports. Actioning a rejected claimant’s report

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI or return to the originating task.
